key_insight: VASPO combines a critic and a self-teacher at the same student-generated prefixes to better align self-distillation with expected return, improving reasoning policy optimization over PPO.
engineering_relevance: For math-reasoning model training, VASPO offers a practical way to mix value-based credit assignment with privileged self-teaching, yielding stronger and more stable updates than using self-distillation alone.
method: Critic estimates token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns.
Self-teacher uses privileged information to scale selected positive advantages with bounded probability ratios.
Designed around positional dynamics: critic improves toward the end of generations, while self-teacher is strongest early and late.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improved mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 points on Qwen3-4B and 1.81 points on OLMo3-7B, and achieved the best mean accuracy on Knights and Knaves.
watch_item: Because VASPO relies on privileged information and bounded ratio-based scaling, its gains may depend on careful synchronization of teacher and critic signals to avoid unstable updates.
paper_title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
